headline: Fonts Module Export Dependencies
what_breaks: packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx — relies on Fonts for rendering text
packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts — depends on Fonts for exporting scenes with text
why: This file exports the Fonts module, which is crucial for text rendering across multiple components. Changes here could disrupt the functionality of several dependent files that rely on font management.
checklist: Review the Fonts module for any breaking changes
Check import paths in App.tsx and FontPickerList.tsx
Ensure compatibility with FontPicker and actionProperties
Verify that exported types from Fonts are intact
